promise: Aim to achieve 2% CPI inflation at the earliest possible time, with an approximately two-year horizon from April 4, 2013
description: The Bank of Japan launched QQE in April 2013 with an approximately two-year horizon for achieving 2% inflation. Its 2017 working paper analyzes why the target was not achieved in that horizon.
evidence: The BOJ's retrospective explicitly identifies the target and the missed two-year horizon.
